RNL ESPANSO uses Android Accessibility only in the focused editable field to match local shortcuts, replace matched text, show local suggestions outside password fields, and undo the last normal-field expansion. Secure-field matching is off by default; when enabled, only the short trigger-length context is requested and no preview is shown. Text is not collected, stored as typing history, or sent off this device. Android will show a system warning because this access can view screen content.

RNL ESPANSO is an offline text-expansion application developed by Manish rnl. It does not require an account and does not include advertising, analytics, tracking SDKs, or internet access.

Data processed

The app stores shortcut keywords, replacement text, folder names, and app settings in private storage on the user's device. CSV data is read or written only when the user selects a file through Android's system document picker.

Accessibility service

The optional accessibility service is required for the app's core text expansion feature when the user types with Gboard, SwiftKey, Samsung Keyboard, or another keyboard. It processes text in the currently focused editable field to:
• match locally stored shortcut keywords;
• insert the selected local replacement;
• show local shortcut suggestions; and
• restore the typed keyword when the user immediately undoes an expansion.

Password fields are ignored by the accessibility service by default. Typed text is not retained as typing history, collected for profiling, shared with third parties, or transmitted off the device.

Payment & Banking App Protection

rnl espanso automatically detects and excludes payment, UPI, banking, and financial applications (including Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay, YONO SBI, BHIM, CRED, and mobile banking apps). Accessibility events and window content from payment apps are completely bypassed and ignored, ensuring payment applications operate securely without security flags or vulnerability warnings.

Optional fallback keyboard

The app includes an optional fallback input method. Text entered through it is processed locally for shortcut matching and is not transmitted or stored as typing history.

Password-field expansion through the bundled keyboard is disabled by default and requires explicit confirmation in Settings. When enabled, only the current trigger buffer is held temporarily in memory for local matching. Replacement previews are not shown in secure fields.

Data sharing and collection

rnl espanso does not collect or share personal data. It has no internet permission and contains no third-party advertising or analytics SDK.

Retention and deletion

Active shortcuts remain in local app storage until the user edits, deletes, or replaces them. Deleted folders and shortcuts remain in the local recycle bin for up to 90 days unless restored or permanently deleted earlier. Uninstalling the app removes its private local data.

Security

Android application-private storage is used for the local database. Android cloud backup is disabled.

Version

Current release: 1.7.0 (versionCode 9)

What it does
• Expands local shortcuts while Gboard, SwiftKey, Samsung Keyboard, or another keyboard remains selected in supported non-password fields.
• Provides an optional bundled keyboard for password-field expansion.
• Stores all shortcuts and settings in app-private device storage.
• Includes no account, backend, ads, analytics, tracking SDK, cloud backup, or internet permission.

Main features
• Android 13+ direct accessibility editor integration
• Android 8-12 accessibility compatibility mode
• Optional secure-field expansion through the bundled keyboard
• Popup suggestions and first-backspace undo
• Folder-based shortcut organization and global search
• Premium System, Light, and Dark themes
• Premium folder creation and shortcut editor interfaces
• Dynamic tokens such as %dd%, %MM%, %yyyy%, %HH%, and %mm%
• CSV import/export through Android's system document picker
• Quoted commas, quotes, and multiline replacement support
• 90-day recycle bin for deleted folders and shortcuts
• In-app privacy policy, developer profile, setup guide, and troubleshooting
• Guided App info to Accessibility flow for Android restricted settings
• Automatic exclusion of payment, banking, and financial apps (Paytm, PhonePe, GPay, SBI, etc.) for device security compliance

Shortcut editor fields
• Keyword: trigger text, for example ;email.
• Replacement text: local text inserted after a match.
• Replace after Space: waits until Space is typed before expanding.
• Folder: organizational folder shown on the home page.
• Position: match priority; lower numbers are checked first.
• Template strategy: compatibility metadata preserved for desktop espanso CSV import/export. Android 1.7.0 does not use it to select a replacement, so leave it blank for normal shortcuts.

Privacy

The app has no internet permission. Shortcuts, settings, and matching remain on the device. CSV files are accessed only through Android's system document picker. Android cloud backup is disabled.

The complete policy is available in PRIVACY_POLICY.md and inside the app under Settings > Privacy policy.
